title: ADL Helps Major AI Labs Suppress Anti Semitism in Source Code

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock
Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
CEO Jonathan Greenblatt announced from Israel that the Anti-Defamation League has partnered with developers of leading artificial intelligence models to eliminate anti-Semitic output from their systems. The organization has collaborated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Alphabet, Google, Meta, and X to test their models for hate speech and guide the firms in developing strategies to address these issues directly within the source code.

Critics have questioned the ADL's role in defining problematic content, noting that the organization lists groups such as Turning Point USA in its Glossary of Extremism. These opponents argue that allowing the ADL to influence AI safeguards enables the organization to suppress ideas it finds problematic across major tech platforms.

selectedTweets.text:
🚨 ADL CEO Jonathan Greenblatt reveals in Israel that he's been working with all the top AI Frontier Labs to push them to suppress "anti-Semitism."

"We've been working with the Frontier Labs—OpenAI, Anthropic, Alphabet, the company that runs Gemini, Google, Meta, who runs Muse, and others, X, who run Grok—testing their models and using the results to push them to do better."

"We've had excellent collaboration with Silicon Valley."

"We've run the tests and seen where anti-Semitism shows up and helped them develop strategies to tackle it right in the source code."
